title: Personalized Basketball Court Perspective Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the excitement of the game right into your bedroom with the sports bedding comforter by Jeminise. This custom comforter is designed for basketball lovers of all ages, offering a cozy and stylish way to show off your passion for the sport. Whether you are decorating a kids' room or updating your own bedding, this personalized comforter adds a unique, energetic touch to any sleeping space.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Make it uniquely yours with custom name and number text inputs.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Sporty Style: Features a vibrant basketball graphic illustration design, perfect for sports enthusiasts.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water for simple maintenance and quick air drying.
  • Included Components: Set comes with a comfortable duvet cover zipper closure.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Style Basketball
Theme Art, Number, Personalized
Pattern Basketball Print
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
